Package io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.core

package io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.core
The protocol, independent of any host.

This package names no host type. It opens no connection, reads no clock and touches nothing outside its OrderingStore, so the same code runs under a deterministic simulator and under Kafka Streams. A test enforces this by scanning the sources.

The safety rule is Deliverability.decide(Causes, Set, Deliverability.SettledView), a pure function of the causes a message expressed, the channels a process receives, and how far each has settled. ProcessEngine holds the state that function reads: a causal frontier (Causes), a per-channel hold-back buffer, and the delivered causal past.

Where the guarantee cannot be upheld, operations throw ParsleyFailClosedException and delivery stops.
